Add two or three broad, distinct bright white cloud banks over the previously clearer central land, spreading toward part of the coast and the left ocean. Make the added clouds materially obvious but realistic in overhead satellite texture. Preserve the coastline geography, underlying terrain, recognisable cloud patterns at the far right, camera angle, full framing and original wide aspect ratio approximately 2.05:1. Do not redraw the land, coast or existing image content outside the added cloud patches. Keep enough coast and terrain visible to recognise the source. Output strictly neutral grayscale with clear contrast, landscape. No text, labels, arrows, symbols, borders or watermark. Only alter cloud cover.
